svg.title: Bring location intelligence into everyday work
svg.desc: Three parallel choices: ArcGIS for Excel to explore spreadsheet data geographically, ArcGIS for Teams to discuss maps together, and ArcGIS for SharePoint to connect content to places. The branches do not represent sequential steps, technical connections, or data flows.

Location context where people already work
Three parallel choices, not sequential steps or data flows.
